items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: You know he’d done work with Miles and with Herbie Mann and a bunch of others.

ctx.x: He wasn’t on the scene all that long, was he?
No, I would say he was kind of young when he passed, man. Sonny was only 52, 53 when he passed. You know he’d done work with Miles and with Herbie Mann and a bunch of others. Pharoah.
If you’re playing an uptempo standard that has a significant number of changes and they’re going by fairly quickly, is it possible to tell us what is going on in your head as you’re playing?
